title: Half of a Yellow Sun
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
summary: Set in Nigeria in the 1960s, the story follows a houseboy, two sisters and an English writer as the Biafran secession turns their comfortable lives into a fight for survival.
readIf: you want a human-scale story of a historical war, told through characters you will not forget.
skipIf: you are not ready for scenes of famine, massacre and sexual violence.

pairings.reason: A foundational Nigerian novel set earlier, showing a society before and during colonial disruption.
Another novel that follows ordinary people through a country torn by conflict, with devastating emotional force.
Offers a different view of Africa during political upheaval, told through a family of outsiders.
